"''I hope not. What a hell that would be.|Qi'ra and Margo, on the carbonite frozen Han Solo|[[War of the Bounty Hunters 1|''War of the Bounty Hunters'' 1]]}} '''Margo''' was an [[Imroosian]] [[Gender|female]] who was part of [[Dryden Vos]]' concierge aboard ''[[First Light]]''''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' in [[10 BBY]]''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' dates the events on the ''[[First Light]]'' in ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' to nine years after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the formation of the Empire to [[19 BBY]], therefore the events on the ''First Light'' in ''Solo'' must take place in [[10 BBY]]. when the [[yacht]] traveled to collect stolen [[coaxium]] from [[Tobias Beckett]] and his [[Beckett's gang|crew]]. Margo handled all guest amenities aboard the ''First Light'', and welcomed Beckett, [[Han Solo]], and [[Chewbacca]] when they arrived. Margo questioned why they came, and Beckett explained that Dryden Vos was expecting him for a meeting. She promised that he'd be with them after dealing with the [[Diles Anevi|Regional Governor]], and both turned to see the [[crime lord]] use his custom [[Petar|kyuzo petar]]s to kill him, ending the meeting. Margo suspected one of the party guests, [[Kara Safwan]], of being up to something, and discreetly blocked the [[spy]]'s attempts to get deeper into the Dryden Vos' inner circle. While on board the ''First Light'', Margo wore a [[Color|black]] [[shimmersilk]] gown and a [[Ottegan charbake smelt necklace]]. She had brown [[eye]]s, and flinty, chalk-like skin. Margo's [[homeworld]] [[Imroosia]] was a [[Volcano|volcanic]] [[planet]], but she personally disliked the [[Temperature|searing]] environment and preferred the ''First Light''{{'s}} cool interior. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|Star Wars allows me to play such a variety of interesting, beautiful creatures, for example Margo. Margo does not have long, flowing locks of hair, nor does she have smooth, blemish free skin, but she is beautiful and powerful regardless.|Charlotte Louise|{{WebCite|url=https://thecloudriders.net/2018/06/29/charlotte-louise-solo-a-star-wars-story-interview-margo|text=Charlotte Louise SOLO: A Star Wars Story Interview – Margo|date=2018-06-29|dateaccessed=2018-07-18|archiveurl=https://archive.is/iZEdR}}}} Margo was portrayed by [[Charlotte Louise]]{{Twitter|RealCharLouise|status/1001532380878921730|Charlotte Louise|quote=More of me as Margo from Solo: A Star Wars Story for you all 👽 #starwars #cfx #solo #hansolo #soloastarwarsstory #lucasfilm #actress #actor #actorslife #model #modelslife #creature #starwarscreatures #film #prosteticmakeup #makeup #blessed #disney #cast|archivefile=File:Charlotte Louise Solo.png}} in the [[2018]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|''Star Wars'' Anthology]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''. Her design was reused concept art of [[Qi'ra]], from when she was originally intended to be an alien.''[[The Art of Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' Louise was cast as Margo after the completion of the [[2017]] [[sequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']]. While she was initially hesitant about portraying Margo because of the plaster costume, she ultimately found it relatively easy to adapt once the process started and enjoyed working with the CFX team
